messages:
Ravi (Finance): Vendor Verdant submitted INV-3345 for $9,200. Invoice has a partial credit line (-$1,200) but no PO reference. AP placed it on hold. PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-3345.pdf
Clara (Procurement): Thanks—pulling PO registry. Do we have any open BLT or project POs for Verdant?
Milo (Platform): We have BLT-780 active for Verdant (support) and PRJ-14 for the migration work. The credit looks like prior-month overbilling correction that should map to PRJ-14.
Verdant AP: Apologies—we included an internal credit memo but missed the PO reference. The correct PO is PRJ-14. Re-uploading corrected invoice INV-3345-v2.pdf with PO field filled.
Ravi (Finance): AP needs either PO on invoice or approver confirmation to match. If PRJ-14 is correct, who signs for project costs?
Milo (Platform): I'm the cost owner for PRJ-14. I approve matching INV-3345 (net $8,000) to PRJ-14. Please split to GL 4100/4105 60/40.
Clara (Procurement): Adding procurement note: "Match to PRJ-14 confirmed; vendor credit accounted; GL split 4100 (60%), 4105 (40%). Approver: Milo (platform)." Memo attached.
ap_bot: System update — invoice INV-3345 updated, procurement note attached, routed to Accounts Payable queue #4590.
Verdant AP: Thanks — can we request expedited payment? Vendor notes cashflow hit from the credit correction.
Ravi (Finance): Payment will be on standard cycle; expediting requires Ops approval and fee. Milo, do you authorize an expedite fee?
Milo (Platform): Not necessary. We can wait one cycle. No expedite fee authorized.
Verdant AP: Understood — appreciate the confirmation.
Ravi (Finance): Match OK. Releasing hold and scheduling for next AP run. :white_check_mark:
Clara (Procurement): I'll add a short audit comment on PRJ-14 explaining the credit link. Closing thread."
